'''Kirk Takill''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as the manager of medical research at the [[New Republic Medical Institute]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Takill once filed a report on the new researcher, a [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] named [[Darkin]]. While considering Darkin to be a diligent, polite, and accurate employee, Takill criticized the Drall for talking too much and offering constant updates on his family. Darkin would also inquire after his co-worker's families and Takill had to tell him that Humans were generally private about their family lives.<ref name="EGTAS" />

Takill told Darkin to keep the family talk to a minimum after the Drall apologized, explaining that not many Drall left their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. However, Takill also noted that Darkin's Human co-workers had become used to the Drall's daily reports and began to ask him about his family, leading to Darkin regularly holding court in the lunchroom to update everyone.<ref name="EGTAS" />
